observations.observation: The aggregate fold shows a dip, while several individual profiles are noisy or incomplete. The numerical leave-sector concern remains; the overview alone does not establish independent-sector robustness.

The folded centre is deeper and more rounded than the mean saved trapezoid. The displayed odd/even curves look fairly close; this display does not cancel the retained alternative-profile parity warning.

Strong sector-35 excursions are retained. Event page 1 shows substantial sector-to-sector depth/noise differences, including deeper sector-89 profiles. Large excursions crowd the overview event labels; the separate event page is readable. Preserve baseline, parity and source concerns.

The several-percent folded dip is strong, and its centre is deeper than the mean saved profile model. The last event page correctly retains the single final event and its missing right-side coverage. Signal strength does not qualify its physical scale, host or binary/blend alternatives.

The long-period fold combines only three signed profiles; primary usability is a separate test. Sector 96 has a steep local baseline and an asymmetric broad feature. The odd/even display is based on one versus two profiles. Preserve sparse support and baseline sensitivity.

Out-of-dip structure and variable individual profiles remain visible around the main dip. Keep the numerical scatter and scanned-dip concerns; these panels do not identify a secondary eclipse or physical host.

Only four signed profiles enter this plotted fold, with three versus one in the parity display; the usable-primary count is separate. Large depth and sparse support retain physical-alternative and timing concerns.

Both the folded and odd/even displays show positive shoulders around the central dip, with residual out-of-dip structure. The simple saved mean profile does not explain that structure; baseline/variability and physical-shape alternatives remain open.
Five signed event profiles support the long-period overview, but individual depths and surrounding structure vary. Preserve sparse-event and timing/physical-source limitations.

The displayed odd/even depths differ visibly with only four profiles in each group. The near-13-day period and retained parity warning remain descriptive concerns, without a calibrated false-positive conclusion.

The fold and nine signed profiles show a several-percent dip. Its centre is deeper than the mean saved profile model, and some events have missing wings. Binary/blend, physical scale and host attribution require further work.

The first and final event pages preserve all 189 profiles in chronological order, including missing bins and individually weak dips. The page headings, last-page range and sector/cycle labels are readable; seeing an aggregate fold does not make every individual event significant.
